body.statement: If \(P\{e(X)=c\}=0\), then \(K_\delta(P)=0\), the regularity theorem applies, and on each of the two fixed branches \(D_P\) equals the ordinary smooth propensity-dependent stochastic-intervention gradient obtained by differentiating \(q_\delta(1\mid x)\) with derivative \(\delta\mathbf 1\{e(x)<c\}\). Thus the result reduces to standard smooth stochastic-policy efficiency theory whenever the cap boundary has no mass.
body.justification: The reduction checks the new gradient against the established smooth calculation away from the kink.
body.gap: Kennedy supplies the smooth branch calculation; the proposition records exact agreement rather than claiming that component as new.
body.consumer: Existing software for smooth stochastic interventions can be validated against the capped formula on datasets with no estimated cap contact.
